imd_perfect_model._note: PERFECT-MODEL test on REAL IMD 0.25 deg JJAS 2020 rain, coarsened 3x to 0.75 deg. Out of distribution: the models were trained at 12->5 km on synthetic mm/6h with all 5 variables; here only rain is given (other channels = training mean), in mm/day. Sea cells are excluded (set equal to the truth).
